standard_references.evidence: Fetched official-source excerpt identifies the SDMX Glossary Version 2.1 and confirms SDMX terminology for Metadata Set, Metadata Structure Definition and Metadata update. The excerpt also confirms COVERAGE_GEO as a cross-domain concept with recommended representation String/Codelist.

Fetched official-source excerpt shows the SDMX Global Registry interface and access to SDMX artefact categories including codelists, concept schemes, metadata structures, metadataflows and structure references. It does not confirm individual report metadata concept IDs used here.
No fetched external excerpt for this guideline was supplied. It remains an authoritative candidate source for later verification of exact SDMX Global Reference Metadata Concept Scheme IDs.

The supplied reference catalog identifies UNSD COICOP as the authoritative source for consumption-purpose classifications. No fetched COICOP excerpt confirming the report's consumption divisions or revision was supplied, so no confirmed COICOP revision is applied.

The supplied reference catalog identifies ISO 4217 as the currency reference source. The report does not name the local currency and no fetched ISO excerpt confirming a specific currency code was supplied, so no ISO 4217 currency code is applied.

limitations: Exact SDMX Global Reference Metadata Concept Scheme IDs and versions could not be confirmed from supplied external evidence for most metadata concepts; the populated values follow the accepted MSD concept IDs, including local concepts where necessary.

The report provides no contact point, source URL, geographic coverage, metadata update date, legal or institutional mandate, publication frequency, detailed collection method, or detailed sampling design; absent optional metadata values are not populated because no verbatim report quote exists for them.

The report states that consumption divisions resemble COICOP but that the revision is not confirmed; therefore classification information is retained as narrative metadata and not as a confirmed COICOP code or revision.
The report uses 'Local currency per household per month' but does not name the currency; therefore no ISO 4217 currency code is assigned.
Dataflow target identifiers are practical local identifiers for this extraction because no separate accepted Dataflow artefact was supplied in the prompt.
Dataflow-level confidentiality notes are not repeated because the report gives one global confidentiality statement and does not state different confidentiality treatment by dataflow.
